sources.title: OpenAI: GPT-6 Sol and Luna release (Sep 22)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: OpenAI released GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna on 2026-09-22 as cost-efficiency frontier models trained with GPT-6 Astra methods; API names gpt-6-sol and gpt-6-luna.
claims.context: First-party announcement page; release event, identity, date.

claims.text: API prices cut 50% vs GPT-5.6 promotional pricing: Sol $4->$2 input and $20->$10 output; Luna $0.20->$0.10 input and $1.20->$0.50 output per 1M tokens.
claims.context: Vendor price card on announcement page; billing independently unverified.

claims.text: Available in ChatGPT Work and Codex for Plus/Pro/Business/Enterprise/Edu from Sep 22; Luna also in desktop app for Free/Go; not in Chat at launch with gradual rollout.
claims.context: Vendor availability statement with stated rollout caveat.

claims.text: Vendor-run evals: AutomationBench Sol xhigh 33.2% at $0.27/task; Agents Last Exam Sol max 56.4%; FrontierCode improvement matching Fable 5.1 xhigh at lower cost; DeepSWE v1.1 Sol max 68.8%; OSWorld 2.0 offline Sol xhigh 60.5%; internal factuality eval ~half the predecessor mistakes.
claims.context: Vendor-run benchmarks with competitor figures from public reports; effort and cost-accounting asymmetries disclosed on page.

claims.text: X community signal is mixed: price reception positive; independent long-task stability complaints (xiaomovps ordinary row) present and neither confirmed nor refuted by the announcement.
claims.context: r3 C1 rows; community signal only.
